name: Classic Potato Salad
recipeIngredient: 3 pounds potatoes (Yukon Gold or red potatoes)

recipeInstructions.name: Cook the Potatoes
recipeInstructions.text: Wash and cut potatoes into bite-sized pieces. Boil in salted water until tender but not falling apart, about 10-15 minutes. Drain and let cool.

recipeInstructions.name: Prepare the Dressing
recipeInstructions.text: In a large bowl, mix mayonnaise, mustard, apple cider vinegar, and sweet pickle relish until well combined. Joni's note: mix and mash some of the potatoes into the dressing.

recipeInstructions.name: Combine Ingredients
recipeInstructions.text: Add the cooled potatoes, diced onion, celery, and chopped eggs to the dressing.

recipeInstructions.name: Season
recipeInstructions.text: Taste and adjust seasoning with salt and pepper. For extra tang, add more mustard or vinegar as desired.

recipeInstructions.name: Chill
recipeInstructions.text: Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour to allow flavors to meld.

description: Best served chilled for maximum flavor. Adjust mustard or vinegar to taste. Great for barbecues, potlucks, and picnics.

name: Build-Your-Own Taco Bar
recipeIngredient: 1 cup shredded cheddar cheese or Mexican blend
1/2 cup black beans, drained and rinsed (optional)
2 cups crushed tortilla chips (for salad option)

itemListElement.name: Brown the Beef
itemListElement.text: In a skillet over medium heat, cook ground beef until browned.

itemListElement.name: Season the Beef
itemListElement.text: Drain excess grease, then add taco seasoning and water. Simmer for 5 minutes until thickened.

itemListElement.name: Season the Chicken
itemListElement.text: If using chicken, shred cooked chicken and toss with cumin, garlic powder, and salt.

itemListElement.name: Mix the Pico
itemListElement.text: In a bowl, mix diced tomatoes, red onion, cilantro, jalapeno if using, lime juice, and salt. Let sit for 10 minutes.

itemListElement.name: Build Your Meal
itemListElement.text: Warm tortillas and set out the meat, toppings, pico de gallo, salad ingredients, and sides so everyone can build a soft taco or assemble a taco salad.

name: Basic Meatloaf

recipeInstructions.name: Preheat the Oven
recipeInstructions.text: Preheat oven to 375F (190C). Grease a loaf pan or line it with parchment paper.

recipeInstructions.name: Prepare the Meat Mixture
recipeInstructions.text: In a large bowl, combine ground beef, breadcrumbs, milk, eggs, onion, garlic, ketchup, Worcestershire sauce, salt, pepper, and thyme if using. Mix until just combined; do not overmix.

recipeInstructions.name: Shape and Top
recipeInstructions.text: Transfer the mixture into the prepared loaf pan and press lightly to shape. In a small bowl, mix the topping ingredients and spread evenly over the meatloaf.

recipeInstructions.name: Bake
recipeInstructions.text: Bake for 50-60 minutes, or until the internal temperature reaches 160F (70C).

recipeInstructions.name: Rest
recipeInstructions.text: Let rest for 10 minutes before slicing and serving.

description: Jarred garlic works fine. Easily doubled.
